note: Cases for the shared host-call collector. It reads no file: the operator shapes (LINT_OPERATOR_SHAPES) and the host facts (LINT_HOST_FACTS) of std-orb-lint-input are kept, and a request is answered once both are heard (or either is unread). The collected calls and the facts are what the same program and the operator table give when walked in the Rust each_call_of order (parent before children, guard before effects, transitions before ticks); the facts cases also check the keys and words indexes of the params by path, the table-ordered emit keys (emitOrder), family and httpWire.

cases.id: a failed input answers unread with no facts
a request before the input is heard waits and is answered by the drain
control: with only the operator shapes heard the request still waits
the waiting request runs once both inputs are heard
the operator shapes are kept and the drain is asked
the host facts are kept and the drain is asked
unread operator shapes fail the read
unread host facts fail the read
